title: Multiple Insulin types as a treatment don't work.
body:
Hello, I am using the most recent nightly build of xdrip, and whenever I try to enter in my lantus for a treatment, the treatment will say it was a fiasp treatment instead. 

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/342300357549883402/662514827867979826/Screenshot_20200102-223611_xDrip.jpg)

comments.body: Same here. Lantus treatment shown and simulated as Humalog.

Along these lines, I'm not understanding how the basal graphing option enabled is meaningful. When enabled it just treats the green insulin curve as one entity regardless of whether I enter my short acting or long acting. Would it be possible to separate those curves and add custom colors to each?
I also don't see how this is suppose to work There needs to be 2 serprate graph lines and we should be able to change  delay time duration and peak time for each entry.

As referenced in #1080  the display function for basal insulin does not work yet. As of now there is no reason to enable the basal graphing option.

This is a work in progress.

> Hello, I am using the most recent nightly build of xdrip, and whenever I try to enter in my lantus for a treatment, the treatment will say it was a fiasp treatment instead.
> 
@ShodyPy are you adjusting the time of your entry?  For me, it appears that the insulin type selection is reset if you change over to the blood test/carb/time screens. Just a little bug. 
Workaround is to enter your time/carbs/blood test first and make the insulin dose the last thing you add.

> I also don't see how this is suppose to work There needs to be 2 serprate graph lines and we should be able to change delay time duration and peak time for each entry.

I agree, 2 graph lines would be ideal with the ability to set colors.  

btw... predictions for Lantus are way off. It just plots the prediction at -3.2mg/dl every 5 minutes which always appears like a forecasted low. I'm not sure if there should be a separate sensitivity setting for this or what
This behaviour is still occurring in 49817a5-2021.10.04. I haven't been able to find any way to enter any kind of basal treatment.
Did anyone find a better way to do this? I am still entering very-long-acting as a treatment note because even nightscout seems to have no better way of representing it.

Basel doses are not included in predictive simulations.
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/1080#issue-517253741

If you believe this should be added, please open a discussions:
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions

When developers don't believe something is needed, discussions are required to see if there may be a way to convince them or why they feel that way.
